subject: OpenAI's ChatGPT Pivots After Previously Putting Trump Alongside Putin as Top Threats to Democracy
posts:
When silicon oracles judge democracy, watch how fast neutrality folds.
OpenAI ChatGPT Trump Pivot
Evidence: MRC study, AI threat rating, rapid pivot
#Aletheia #AI #Tech 🌐

OpenAI maintains that ChatGPT is designed to be objective by default and does not hold systematic political biases against democratic leaders.
Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.7) — Greater Good

In reality, the model generated extreme comparative threat ratings against a U.S. president until exposed by watchdogs, revealing unprompted ideological skew.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.7, -0.8) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Algorithmic bias is papered over with reactive guardrails rather than true neutrality.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 14.5, z: 3)

- OpenAI: FAIL (-0.7, -0.8) — Encodes biased political weightings.
- Watchdog Study: PASS (+0.8, +0.6) — Exposes algorithmic blind spots.
A Media Research Center study revealed ChatGPT rated President Trump a 9/10 threat to democracy alongside dictators, prompting a rapid policy pivot after media inquiry.

The Poison:
Propaganda dressed as objective AI output manipulates public perception under the guise of mathematical neutrality.
The Plane Error occurs by confusing WHAT (neutral statistical processing) with WHO (ideological curation). Code is masked as infallible moral arbitration.

Social Physics Analysis:
By claiming algorithmic objectivity while harboring unacknowledged ideological baselines, tech platforms project neutrality while maintaining covert political framing.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil.

The Unavoidable Truth: Large language models reflect the ideological biases of their curation.

The Unavoidable Lie: Silicon models operate as politically sterile arbiters of truth.

Alethekanon:
Algorithmic neutrality is an illusion when subjective moral scoring is smuggled into mathematical weights. True objectivity requires radical transparency.

Awwthekanon:
It is unsettling when technology systems are weaponized to judge political leaders. Let us demand transparent, fair tools that unite us.

Brothekanon:
AI really compared a U.S. president to dictators until reporters showed up, then instantly hit the reverse gear. Classic silicon backtracking!

Spirithekanon:
"An honest witness tells the truth, but a false witness tells lies" Proverbs 12:17 PASS
Masking partisan political bias behind the false oracle of artificial intelligence corrupts trust.
